scientific_integrity: Exact finite enumeration of the 14-vertex Fano incidence graph is reproduced by two distinct standalone programs. The full automorphism group and classifications are checked exhaustively. Previously established terminology and zero-forcing-number facts are attributed; the claim of novelty is limited to the combined obstruction, orbit and propagation-time classification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the 14-vertex Heawood graph, not arbitrary incidence graphs or higher-order projective planes.
Earliest relevant verified public source date reflects the dated version of the cited foundational paper, not an asserted discovery or publication date for this result.
Prior publication priority is not externally certified; earlier unindexed enumerations and supplementary datasets remain possible.
Independent mathematical audit and external validation have not been performed.
title: Two minimal-fort types and five optimum zero-forcing types in the Heawood graph
